integrity: The finite-sample identity follows from an explicitly inverted bilateral transform; the asymptotic follows from exponential tilting and a local CLT. The included standalone checker uses exact rational arithmetic and numerical corroboration. Publication priority is not independently certified; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
limitations: The exact probability and sharp asymptotic apply to exactly two agents with independent Uniform(0,1) nonnegative additive marginal values, complete allocations and a fixed number m of goods; the asymptotic lets m tend to infinity. No extension to correlated, heterogeneous, multilateral or nonadditive environments is established.
title: Exact finite-sample envy-freeness and a sharp error exponent for welfare-maximizing allocations
